gloss: running wild, rampage, going out of control

definitions.explanation: Moving in an uncontrolled, reckless manner, often referring to vehicles or people acting without restraint.

examples.japanese: {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{止|と}める。
{車|くるま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暴走|ぼうそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The car went out of control.

examples.japanese: {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To put a stop to the rampage.

notes:
{暴走|ぼうそう} means running wild or going out of control.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {暴走|ぼうそう}する (to run wild, to go berserk)
- {暴走|ぼうそう}{族|ぞく} (biker gang, motorcycle gang)
- {暴走|ぼうそう}{行為|こうい} (reckless driving)

Used for vehicles out of control, people acting without restraint, or systems malfunctioning.
